text:
Devon: hey team, excited to start! i'm blocked on sign-in — Okta rejects my device and 1Password invite never arrived. also can't see the eng team drive. anyone point me to the right place?

Rina (IT): welcome Devon! :wave: which laptop/os are you on and are you on a corporate or hotel/home network? sometimes captive portals block device enrollment.

Devon: macbook air, macOS 13.4, i'm on hotel wifi at the moment. Okta shows 'Device not compliant: device trust required' and when i click enroll the page sits on a spinner then times out. 1Password email missing in inbox and spam.

it-ops-bot: Ticket INC-3031 created: okta-enroll-timeout for thread 2681239999. Assigned to Rina (IT). ETA 3h.

Rina (IT): thanks — sounds like captive portal or a DNS/proxy issue. quick steps: 1) try a phone hotspot (rarely blocks), 2) if you're on hotel wifi sign into the captive portal first, 3) run `profiles status -type enrollment` and paste output, 4) if jamf shows no profile try `sudo jamf enroll -prompt`.

Devon: tried captive portal and accepted terms, still stuck. here's `profiles status -type enrollment` output:

Device is enrolled via MDM: NO
MDM server: none

Devon: also tried Safari incognito, same result.

Tom (Infra): if MDM says NO then Okta will block. Rina, can you push a forced re-enroll? I can also add Devon to a temporary share link for eng-drive.

Rina (IT): pushing Jamf enroll link now and reissuing Okta device cert. you'll get an email from Jamf and a separate SSO validation link. Also resending 1Password invite.

1Password-bot: 1Password invite resent to devon@redwood.dev (item: Redwood - New Hire Seat).

Devon: got the Jamf link, running `sudo jamf enroll -prompt` now. it asked for SSO login and installed profile. output says enrolled.

Devon: ran `profiles status -type enrollment` again:

Device is enrolled via MDM: YES
MDM Server: Jamf Pro (jamf-01)
Profiles installed: 2

Rina (IT): perfect. i'm clearing the Okta device-trust flag and re-validating your account. try logging into okta in a fresh browser window.

Devon: OK logged in — Okta accepted device trust and prompted to set up a passkey (i skipped for now). i can see eng-drive and the 1Password invite appeared, accepted it and set a master password.

Tom (Infra): added you to eng-all and shared a temporary eng-drive link for any missing files: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/temp-eng-share

Marta (People Ops): welcome Devon! added you to the new hires intro meeting at 3pm, see calendar.

Rina (IT): updating INC-3031: resolved via Jamf re-enroll + Okta cert reissue. note to team: hotels with captive portals caused two recent similar enroll fails — added to onboarding KB. if anyone hits this, try a phone hotspot first.

Devon: thanks everyone — appreciate the quick help! will enroll a passkey later. :grinning:
